cohort: Over 12 million births in the United States between 1999 and 2013
finding: Pregnant women with muscular dystrophy were found to be at an increased risk of several adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes, including preeclampsia, preterm labor, cesarean section, and preterm birth.
mod_finding: Women with muscular dystrophy were found to have an increased risk of giving birth by cesarean section.
